stories.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case as outbreak spreads into western Africa
bullet_points: Case in Africa’s most populous country was detected in a woman who had travelled from Uganda  Nigeria has confirmed an Ebola case in its capital, Abuja, after a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive for the virus, the health ministry said.
The woman began showing symptoms on 7 October and was admitted to a hospital in Abuja four days later, where she was later diagnosed with Ebola.
It is unclear when she arrived in Nigeria, Africa’s most populous country.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
bullet_points: 41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’    Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record    Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is  set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s .
Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s.

It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.
